It seemed like Kelly might be on her way to a third victory by getting Matthew on her team, but unfortunately for her, Blake also turned around. He made a very good case, noting that three of his past six winners were not country singers, stating, "It doesn't matter what lane your coach is in. It's what lane your coach can put you in."
